integrity: A full all-length elementary proof and standalone finite falsification scripts are included. Finite checks confirm specified ranges and are not treated as infinite certification.
scientific_limitations: Binary alphabet, sequential adjacent swaps, radius two only. Exact correction-locality criterion, not a code-size or algorithmic-complexity bound; the independent external audit has not been performed. Historical priority remains subject to unindexed equivalent work.
title: Sharp two-block locality for correcting two successive adjacent swaps in binary block codes
